dz: 丹达拉多斯·帕尔马雷斯是巴西前逃亡奴隶多斯·帕尔马雷斯的首领,被俘虏并自杀,而不是被送回奴隶生活.
de: Dandara dos Palmares, leader of the runaway slaves in Quilombo dos Palmares, Brazil, is captured and commits suicide rather than be returned to a life of slavery.
